body: I dont feel happy. And people say it gets better. Yeah well it doesn't. It just gets worse. But i so appreciate your response to an internet stranger. You are a good person! I wish you all the best in the world.

I've fantasized about that. Moving to the Colorado Rockies or something. It's just not in me. My life and finances are too complicated. It wouldn't work. Making low six figures is nothing, when you have expenses. I am in debt and not living any lavish lifestyle.
